annotations.title: Convert hourly pay to gross salary

description: Convert an hourly wage into gross annual, monthly, semimonthly, biweekly, weekly, and daily pay, including overtime. Uses the same formula as the AuraCalcs hourly to salary page. This is gross pay before tax. Estimate only.

hourly.description: Hourly wage in dollars. Same field as the website.

ot.description: Overtime hours per week. Defaults to 0.

unpaidWeeks.description: If paid weeks are omitted, paid weeks are 52 minus this number.

weeks.description: Paid weeks per year. Defaults to 52.

name: convert_hourly_to_salary
